body: The `PoolSnapshot::deltas_to` method (tracing.rs:227-245) uses `f64::EPSILON` (~2.2e-16) as the threshold for reporting pool changes. This is extremely sensitive — for pool values in typical simulation ranges (0.01 to 1000), even innocuous arithmetic like `x = x * 1.0` or reading/writing through an intermediate can produce rounding noise that exceeds this threshold. Consider using a relative-or-absolute threshold, e.g. `delta.abs() > 1e-12 || (delta / before_val).abs() > 1e-12`, to suppress sub-picogram noise while still catching real sub-microgram changes relevant to budget tracking.
